locations.description: This is your room, a small enclosure where you sleep, and spend most of your time looking through your telescope, which is in front of the window. A bed and a closet are the only notable things. The room has two doors, one to the North and one to the West.
The upstairs hallway is somewhat narrow, and only connects to your room to the South and to the lower floor, via a staircase. A small wheelchair lift runs along the entire staircase.
You are in the kitchen. An oven, a wooden table, and a cupboard are the only visible furniture. Stairs, with a lift, allow access to the upper floor. To the East, you distinguish a door.

In the living room of the house, all is tranquility. A pair of armchairs, next to a tiny sideboard, are in a corner. The floor is covered by a huge carpet with geometric patterns. The exit gate is to the South. Separate doors, to the East and to the West, lead to different rooms.

The dining room is quite a sight. A designer table, made of oak wood; quite an antique; surrounded by several chairs (six in fact), also belonging to the same design as the table. Silver candelabras decorate its surface, and beautiful paintings hang from the walls, along with a shelf with books.

In the bathroom. A familiar smell penetrates your nostrils, while a feeling of nausea invades your stomach. You see the usual: a toilet, a sink, and a bathtub. The walls are covered with sky-blue tiles.

This small room gives you claustrophobia. The flashlight's beam illuminates the grimy and damp walls of this place. The exit hatch is easily distinguishable from here, as it is a steel door. A lever on the wall tempts you to move it.

The neglected garden has only two or three withered flowers, among the fresh and tall grass. The door to your house is to the North. To the South, you see the exit gate, and a little further away, Janice's house.
Estás en la calle Main, que comunica con el aerop al E, situ a más de 10Km de dist. Al W disting una cab telefnica. Al S la casa de Janice.
La calle Main continúa tanto al E como al W, y parece perderse en el horiz. No te parece una buena idea ir hasta el aerop a pie...
Continúas en la calle Main. Ahora estás frente a la vacía cab telefnica. Al E puedes ver tu casa, y la casa de Janice. Al W, la calle se pierde en el horiz.
En el interior de la claustrofóbica cab de telfono. El telc numérico, junto a una ranura donde insertar las monedas, y el auricular, esperan ser utilizados.
El aerop parece pequeño desde aquí. Los portones de cristal dejan ver el interior, que está abarrot de gente. La calle continúa tanto al E como al W.
El interior del aerop es ruidoso y algo agobiante. Una ventanilla situ cerca de ti indica el despacho de billetes. Al E se encuentra la sala de espera, mientras que al W está la zona de embarque.

Estás en la sala de espera. Múltiples sillones formando círculos concéntricos son ocupados por la gente. A ti tampoco te parece mala idea descansar un rato...
Lo más que llegas a ver es un panel con los horarios de embarque, y el despacho de billetes situ al W.
Tras varios empujones y pisotones (donde las dan, las toman), logras llegar a la zona de embarque. La aduana se sitúa al N. Al E puedes ver el despacho de billetes.

El interior del avión es confortable. Numerosos asientos se sitúan en dos filas, cada una a un lado del avión. Los asientos están agrupados de tres en tres. Esta es la zona para pasajes de primera clase. Al E comienzan los de segunda clase. Una puerta al W te separa de la cabina del piloto.

Aquí se sientan los pasajeros de segunda clase. No parece que el avión esté muy repleto de gente. Al W comienzan los asientos de primera clase, y al E ves la puerta de la cabina de carga. En el N, una pequeña portezuela abre paso al baño.
The bathroom is of the simplest kind: a rather small toilet, and a tiny sink on which rests, on the wall, a mirror. The exit door is to the South.
The cargo hold is crammed with boxes and suitcases. Although there is not much light, you can make out a pole in the center of the enclosure. To the West are the airplane seats.
The interior of the taxi is quite comfortable. The driver is a mustachioed man with large eyes. He has his hands on the steering wheel.

 Dear Sam:
      Despite how little we know each other, I have decided to send you this letter because I feel you are the únly person in this place whom I can trust, do not ask me why...
      Without a doubt, when this letter reaches your hands, I will probably already be dead. Since I arrived í, I have tried to keep my distance and not give many clues about my work or my new identity.

{paper:white}{ink:black}      However, they have found me. You will ask yourself what devils I am talking about; if I stop to think about it, even I myself think it is incredible. My real name is not Janice, but Angela; I do not work for a fashion store, I am a CIA agent. My mission, and the reason I am here, is to destroy a criminal organization called DEDALOS.
It is the documents that speak of DEDALOS.
He is a man of about 40 years, dressed in a black jacket and dark brown pants. He does not stop looking at you.
They are all portraits.
In total, you have one dollar.
Don looks at you with confused eyes.
Don sits down.
Don growls and leaves.

{paper:white}{ink:black}      The way to achieve it is to deliver the documents I am sending you with the letter to CIA headquarters. They list several names of the big shots of DEDALOS, and the places where they plan to commit their next criminal acts. Until now, I worked with Frank Drake, but I soon discovered that he was a traitor to the orders of DEDALOS.

{paper:white}{ink:black}      I fled as fast as I could from his reach, because he wanted to snatch the documents from me. When I thought I had gotten rid of him, he appeared again. Tomorrow I have to meet him at my house, which is why I have decided to move these papers from my reach and Frank's.

{paper:white}{ink:black}      Now listen well: if I die, it will be up to you to get the documents to Washington. If you do not wish to risk embarking on such a dangerous adventure, you can always turn the documents over to the police, but remember that if you do this, the world will be condemned. The decision is yours. I hope you choose the right path...

Don sniffs the floor.
Don stares intently at you.
Don circles you nervously.

Looking through the telescope, you see Janice's kitchen. She is there, but she doesn't seem to be alone. Two men, whose faces you cannot quite make out, are with her.
The lens is not very precise; it would need to be replaced.
You see Janice's kitchen. You don't see her anywhere, nor do you make out anyone in the room. The lens is not very precise; it would need to be replaced.
Logically, search the whole house for the lens.
You can't, you don't have the right lens.
Don is coming.
Don is here, sitting.

Looking through the telescope, you see Janice lying on the kitchen floor. She is dead! The men who were with her have left.
Next to Janice's corpse, there is a message written on the wall.

It seems Janice wrote it with her own blood before she died.
The message reads: {2}"Run Sam, they are going there"{1}
Suddenly, Don starts growling. It seems someone has entered the house.
The most logical thing to do would be to call the police, but first you will have to make sure Janice's killers don't catch you.
You see two guys coming out of Janice's house. ¡They've seen you!
¡My God! You see two guys here, one of them armed...
Don is coming.
Don, your dog, is here.
After pulling the tile you see that there is a button in its place.
When changing the lens, the old one falls to the floor and breaks.
When pressing the button, the west wall opens and a secret room appears.
When looking through the telescope you see Janice's kitchen. Two guys are with her. ¡Oh, no! One of them is armed. Janice is frightened.
¡My God! The armed individual shoots Janice. She falls to the ground, lifeless. After this act, the guys look through the window. ¡No! They have seen you. ¡And they have left the room in a hurry!
You pull the lever, and the wall closes.
You pull the lever again, and the wall opens.
You press the button, and the west wall closes again.
You hear voices. You see guys entering the bathroom. ¡They've seen you! Of course, the wall is open...
Two guys enter this room... ¡one of them armed!
You type the number. It immediately starts calling.
A voice answers: {2}"{ink:yellow}Police Department{ink:white}"{1}
The voice says: {2}"{ink:yellow}Hello, ¿what is happening?{ink:white}"{1}
The operator has hung up.
You pick up the receiver.
You insert the coins. The telephone waits for a call.
Don growls. Suddenly, one of Janice's killers enters the cabin, brandishing a revolver. The man says: {2}"{ink:green}You're gonna die, you fucking cripple...{ink:white}"{1}
The man shoots at you. Little by little, you feel your life fluids escaping your body...
Don jumps on the man, who tries to shake him off.
The guy shakes Don off with a strong blow. Afterward, and without reconsidering anything, he shoots at you. You feel your life fluids escaping your body...

Taking advantage of the fact that he is distracted with Don, you shoot at him, hitting him in an arm. Wounded and alarmed, the man leaves the cabin and runs down the street, upon hearing the siren of a police car. A man gets out of the car and says to you: {2}"{ink:yellow}Well, ¿how about you accompany me to ask him a few questions?{ink:white}"{1}
After several hours at the police station talking with the policeman, they let you go. You retire to your house to rest. You are exhausted, and quickly fall asleep...
There is a taxi here, waiting.
The taxi driver says: {2}"{ink:white}¿Where to?"{1}
The taxi driver says: {2}"{ink:white}O.K."{ink:cyan}. He starts the engine and drives off...
We have arrived. The taxi driver says: {2}"{ink:white}That'll be 15 dollars".{1}
You pay the taxi driver. He says: {2}{ink:white}"Have a good trip, sir".{1}
A man, sitting next to you, can't stop looking at you...
Don gets up.
Inside the cupboard, you find a small bottle.
You notice someone is trying to force the door...
¡Don't ask for so much help and try to solve it yourself!

{2}-{ink:green}We've searched the whole house and there's no trace of that coward.

{ink:white}-{ink:magenta}I think he's gone. It would be better if we leave before the police arrive{ink:white} - says the other guy.
